name: SFA Team Performance
query: SELECT v.owner AS "Salesperson:Link/User:150", COUNT(v.name) AS "Total Visits:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'Order Taken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Successful Orders:Int:120", SUM(CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'No Order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "No Orders:Int:100", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'Order Taken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(v.name)) * 100, 2) AS "Conversion Rate:Data:120" FROM `tabVisit Log` v WHERE DATE(v.start_time) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s GROUP BY v.owner

name: SFA Expense Summary
query: SELECT sales_user AS "Salesperson:Link/User:150", expense_type AS "Expense Type:Data:120", SUM(amount) AS "Total Amount:Currency:120", COUNT(name) AS "Entries:Int:80" FROM `tabSFA Expense` GROUP BY sales_user, expense_type

name: SFA Visit & Value Report
query: SELECT v.owner AS "Salesperson:Link/User:150", v.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150", v.custom_latitude AS "Lat:Data:100", v.custom_longitude AS "Lng:Data:100", v.start_time AS "Check-In:Datetime:150", TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, v.start_time, v.end_time) AS "Duration (Mins):Int:100", v.outcome AS "Outcome:Data:100", IFNULL((SELECT SUM(grand_total) FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE customer = v.customer AND docstatus = 1 AND transaction_date = DATE(v.start_time)), 0) AS "Order Value:Currency:120" FROM `tabVisit Log` v ORDER BY v.start_time DESC
